title: Energy Systems
hook: Spending your sharpest hours on email is why the real work feels so hard by 4pm.
statement: You don't really manage time. You manage your energy.
explainer: An hour at full energy can be worth three tired ones. Put your best work in your peak hours and push the admin into the slumps.
sop: Track your energy hourly for 3 days: high, medium, or low.
Find your top 2 daily energy peaks.
Score your Energy and Time Used during those peaks 1 to 10.
Move your highest-value work into the peaks and admin into the dips.
Protect your peaks with sleep, food, and a good setup.
equation_example: Energy 8, Time Used 7, meaning you protected most of your peak hours for real work. 8 × 7 = 56 out of 100. Higher means good energy is matched with focused time. Lower means one of them is leaking somewhere.
question: Write down when your energy peaks and what you usually do during that window.
closing_statement: Time without energy behind it doesn't produce much.
caption:
Principle Nº 131: Energy Systems

Spending your sharpest hours on email is why the real work feels so hard by 4pm.

You don't really manage time. You manage your energy.

Your turn: Write down when your energy peaks and what you usually do during that window.
